description: This file defines an Angular component named MultipleChoice, which provides a dropdown UI element with options, handles user selection changes, and integrates with a dynamic component framework.

classes.name: MultipleChoice
classes.description: An Angular component extending DynamicComponent that renders a multiple-choice dropdown with dynamic options and handles change events.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events on the select element, updating the data model when user makes a selection.
